messages:
alex walker: Quick followup from today's all-hands — thanks for the updates! A few field questions re: pipeline / partners.
maria chen: happy to take these. fire away.
alex walker: 1) For the top 3 deals you mentioned, what's the primary blocker — pricing vs data residency vs integrations?
jasper li: from eng side we saw two were waiting on Private deployment onboarding (VPC) and one on model certs.
sarah nguyen: sales note: pricing flexibility was the blocker for the mid-market deal; enterprise needed a committed throughput SLA.
maria chen: summary — Deal A: Data residency (on-prem eval). Deal B: Pricing/commit size. Deal C: integration work (SAML + SIEM).
alex walker: 2) On partner GTM — are we prioritizing co-sell with cloud partners or ISV embed deals?
maria chen: Short answer: both, but sequence depends on partner. For hyperscalers we lean cloud region + marketplace first. For ISVs we push embed + joint solutions.
jasper li: any docs for partner dev flows? looking for onboarding checklist for ISV embeds.
alex walker: would be helpful to have a one-pager: "what success looks like" for partners + required integration checklist.
maria chen: agree. @zach can we scope a field playbook (1 pager + 2 sample pitch templates) by EOW?
zach: yep, can spin up draft by Friday. will add a short ROI slide with token cost comps.
alex walker: 3) Demo SKUs — can we get clearer guidance on what to show for Dedicated vs Hosted?
sarah nguyen: field practice: show live latency + price knobs for Hosted; show isolation & SLA for Dedicated. Keep prompts simple.
jasper li: also include a quick quantization/throughput callout — eg gpt-4x-32k -> expected tps numbers on c4-equivalent.
maria chen: good. we'll add recommended scripts to the playbook.
alex walker: last: any change to partner referral fees / deal registration process?
maria chen: no changes this quarter. we are testing a pilot with two partners for accelerated deal credit — update in next all-hands.
alex walker: thanks. can someone drop links to the partner program doc and the renewal playbook?
zach: added links: https://redwood.co/partners/playbook (draft) and https://redwood.co/sales/renewals (internal)
ops-bot: Meeting recording uploaded: https://meetings.redwood.co/recordings/1948123456
maria chen: thanks everyone. if any follow-ups, DM me or drop here. :thumbsup:
jasper li: I'll add the onboarding checklist to the eng repo and ping when ready.
alex walker: awesome — appreciate fast turnaround.
